772420101.text: Ugh... Can we go back, Javita?

772420103.text: I... I don't know what to do anymore. I'm Kintutu, and I'm a...

772420106.text: Yes, and this guy running around is my friend, Javita...

772420107.text: *sigh* Maybe we shouldn't have come to Snezhnaya. Javita got kinda gloomy the moment we arrived.

772420108.text: Logic says that Flowfire Birds shouldn't be afraid of the cold... But maybe it's not about fear. Maybe the sudden change in environment's just made her uncomfortable...

772420109.text: So, at the locals' recommendation, I came to this hot spring... and wouldn't you know it? Javita perked up right away.

772420110.text: Maybe even a bit too much — she's broken all the railings, running this way and that. There's been no stopping her, either. If I went one way, she'd go another, and so on...

772420111.text: I need some way to block her path a bit... Or chase her out of the water, hmph!

772420401.text: (A notice planted in the wilds. It reads as follows...)

772420402.text: "This hot spring was created by the runoff of (...) pipes, and is thus the common property of all. Please maintain it carefully... and do not under any circumstances report it to the Energy Commission."

772420403.text: "Humans, please take off your dirty clothes and wash yourselves before entering... Volkodlak should remove any loose fur first... And if you Vila are going to gripe about this and that and everything, just don't come here, alright?"

772420404.text: "For Jack Frosts and Snegovik, please pay attention to the length of time you spend in here... to avoid fainting due to overexposure..."

772420405.text: Huh, looks like a list of "things you should take note of at a hot spring."

772420406.text: Still, can Jack Frosts and Snegovik really take hot spring baths? Do you think they'll pop out afterward and say, "This hot spring is pretty good for losing weight" or something?

772420201.text: Finally, the Flowfire Bird that had gone berserk in the hot springs calmed down, growing almost sad, as if realizing that this place was not home.

772420202.text: Wow. Paimon never thought we'd see a look of dejection on this Flowfire Bird's face.

772420203.text: Javita! Oh, you... Finally calmed down, huh?

772420206.text: Hehe, well, as long as she's calmed down, huh?

772420207.text: Thank you both so, so much! I think we should head back soon, for her health's sake if nothing else...

772420208.text: I really don't know how to thank you two... Oh yeah. You say "thank you" too, Javita!

772420211.text: Well, so long as she understands you!
